title: JACKLY JK-6036A 31-in-1 Multi-Function Precision Magnetic Tool Kit Screwdriver Set

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The JACKLY JK-6036A 31-in-1 Multi-Function Precision Magnetic Tool Kit Screwdriver Set is a reliable and versatile toolkit designed for technicians, DIY users, and anyone who needs a compact solution for electronics and gadget repair.

This high-quality set includes 30 precision chrome-vanadium steel bits and a durable, ergonomic magnetic handle that ensures maximum control during delicate repair tasks. Whether you're working on smartphones, laptops, cameras, toys, or small home appliances, this toolkit offers the accuracy and flexibility you need. Its portable, lightweight storage case keeps all bits organized and easily accessible, making the JACKLY JK-6036A an ideal choice for both home and professional use in Bangladesh.


Key Features

  • 31-in-1 Complete Toolkit – Includes 30 interchangeable precision bits and 1 magnetic screwdriver handle.
  • High-Quality Material – Bits are made from durable chrome-vanadium steel for long-lasting performance.
  • Magnetic Screwdriver Handle – Provides stronger grip on screws, making delicate repair work easier.
  • Ergonomic Non-Slip Grip – Comfortable handle design reduces hand fatigue during extended use.
  • Wide Application – Perfect for mobile phones, laptops, cameras, watches, small appliances, and electronics repair.
  • Compact & Portable Case – Lightweight, organized storage box ideal for technicians and on-the-go repair work.
  • Multi-Bit Compatibility – Includes Torx, Phillips, Flat, Hex, Tri-Point, Triangle, Pentalobe, and other specialty bits.
  • Ideal for Professionals & DIY Users – Great for hobbyists, repair shops, and home users needing precision tools.
